essence:
How can the self be the *eternal* knower, if memory reaches only what one has
experienced — and the Rāmāyaṇa was composed by Vālmīki long ago, whom I was not?

If memory reaches only the experienced, then I was not at the time of the Rāmāyaṇa — for that time
was not experienced by me.
Where the conceit of the experiencer is firm in the body, there the memory-ness is clear.
